required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard application cover sheet submitted through Grants.gov.

required_documents.name: Direct Care Workforce Technical Assistance Plan
required_documents.details: Three-year technical assistance work plan to operate the Direct Care Workforce Strategies Center, addressing direct care worker shortages, turnover, compensation, and career pathways.

required_documents.name: Cross-Sector Stakeholder Engagement Strategy
required_documents.details: Plan for cross-sector national collaboration uniting state Medicaid, aging, disability, labor, and education agencies with consumers and workers.

required_documents.name: SF-424A Budget Information and 3-Year Narrative
required_documents.details: Budget breakdown requesting up to ,000,000 across the 3-year cooperative agreement.

required_documents.name: Key Personnel CVs and Project Leadership Qualifications
required_documents.details: Resumes and qualifications of project director and key technical assistance personnel in direct care workforce policy.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active UEI Registration
required_documents.details: Active Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) on SAM.gov.

eligibility.summary: Open to nonprofit organizations, higher education institutions, state agencies, faith-based and community organizations with national technical assistance capacity. Foreign entities are ineligible.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing is not required for this cooperative agreement.

review_criteria.criterion: Demonstrated Expertise in Direct Care Workforce Systems and Policy
Quality of Technical Assistance Strategy for State Agencies and Employers
Capacity Building, Toolkit Dissemination, and Stakeholder Engagement

funded_activities.activity: Operating the national Direct Care Workforce Strategies Center to support states in recruiting, retaining, and developing direct care workers.
Providing tailored technical assistance, policy toolkits, and wage/compensation modeling to state aging and disability agencies.
Promoting cross-sector state partnerships to ensure older adults and people with disabilities can safely live and fully participate in their communities.

submission_limits: One (1) cooperative agreement award will be made nationally.
important_notes: Single national cooperative agreement award up to ,000,000 for 3 years.
Requires national technical assistance capacity across aging and disability sectors.
